training.note: Best-checkpoint-tracked all-tracks curriculum run (configs/classic_all_tracks.json, run sensor_best_run_20260901) over the full Easy/Medium/Pro curriculum, warm-started from the prior single-track smoke policy. Periodic evaluation during training kept the best-scoring checkpoint (this one) rather than shipping whichever network existed when the clock ran out: the run's own final checkpoint regressed to 10.0% finish rate / 0.333 mean progress, confirming the same late-training value-collapse behavior documented in docs/policy-comparison.md. This bundled policy is the best checkpoint, not the final one.

reference_evaluation.note: One episode per curriculum environment (all 30 Easy/Medium/Pro tracks), deterministic, seed 2000007. Solves 7/10 Easy tracks (Intro, Shorty, Slope, Knolls, Cliff, Hole, Original); Medium/Pro tracks are not yet solved.
